text:
Leah Ortiz: Heads-up  timeline compression this cycle due to the hiring freeze and a vendor outage. Handbacks + manager forms still due Fri 11:59pm PST but were adding emergency reviewer slots Mon/Tue if you cant make the original schedule.

Ben Park: Clarify emergency slot flow?

Leah Ortiz: If a manager cant attend their assigned calibration, add `emergency_reviewer` in the form or email people-ops with the name. Well try to use those Mon/Tue slots. Only use in true emergencies so scheduling stays sane.

Camille Ruiz: Any change to CSV headers with the compressed timeline? I automate uploads nightly.

Leah Ortiz: No header change. Canonical CSV: `email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,emergency_reviewer,preferred_slot,notes,attachments_link`. Use ISO dates. `attachments_link` can be a comma-separated list of doc URLs.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: 60 managers have not completed handbacks. Deadline Fri 11:59pm PST. If you are impacted by vendor outage, tag `@people-ops` below. :warning:

Ben Park: We have several timezone-heavy teams. How are you balancing AM/PM preferences with compressed calendar?

Leah Ortiz: Prioritize timezone fairness: mark `preferred_slot` AM/PM in CSV. Well cluster by region where possible. If a manager explicitly needs remote/asynchronous handback, set `async: yes` in notes and include an evidence summary link.

Camille Ruiz: For evidence, is a bullet list in the attachments doc OK or do you prefer inline notes? Some managers paste long narratives.

Leah Ortiz: Bullet summaries in the attachments doc are perfect. Keep inline `notes` concise (1-2 lines) and put supporting evidence in the doc. People-ops may sample packets and ask for 2-3 corroborating artifacts (tickets, PR links, customer emails).

HR Ops: Confidential promotions  set `confidential: yes` in the CSV and include a private packet link. Well redact for broader calibration and schedule an HR-present block.

Ben Park: If a manager is on travel and proxy gets sick, can people-ops assign a temporary reviewer?

Leah Ortiz: Yes  escalate to the manager's lead. To avoid that, add `emergency_reviewer` now or email people-ops@redwood.com with backup names.

people-ops-bot: Upload endpoint supports up to 8MB. If your attachments exceed that, host docs in internal Drive and include `attachments_link`. :paperclip:

Camille Ruiz: One more Q  will the compressed timeline affect promotion packets review window?

Leah Ortiz: Promotion packets get the same review priority but slightly shorter skip-level window (48h instead of 72h). Well notify skip-levels directly. If you need the full 72h for complex cases, flag `skip_level_ext: yes` in notes and people-ops will review exceptions.

Ben Park: Uploading CSV now with emergency_reviewer filled. Thanks.

Leah Ortiz: Thanks team  well post the emergency slot schedule by EOD today. Ping me or people-ops@redwood.com for urgent edge cases. :sparkles:
